name: AI-Code-Reviewer Enterprise Default Rules
description: Conservative, local-only advisory rules for security-sensitive coding patterns. Review each finding in context.

rules.description: A subprocess call enables shell=True, which can expose command construction to shell injection risks.
rules.suggestion: Avoid shell=True where possible. Pass a fixed command and argument list, and validate any untrusted input.

rules.description: ProcessBuilder invokes a shell with -c, which can expose dynamically constructed commands to injection risks.
rules.suggestion: Prefer fixed command arguments without a shell. Validate and constrain all externally influenced values.

rules.description: exec.Command launches a shell with -c, which can expose dynamically constructed commands to injection risks.
rules.suggestion: Use a fixed executable and explicit arguments; do not concatenate untrusted values into a shell command.

rules.description: Rust Command invokes a shell with -c, which can expose dynamically constructed commands to injection risks.
rules.suggestion: Use Command with a fixed executable and separately supplied, validated arguments.

rules.description: A JavaScript shell command execution API is used. Review command construction and input validation.
rules.suggestion: Prefer execFile or spawn with fixed arguments, and avoid interpolating untrusted input into commands.

rules.description: A credential-like value appears to be hardcoded in source code.
rules.suggestion: Move secrets to an approved secret manager or environment variable, then rotate any exposed credential.
